company.name: Stable
company.shortDescription: Stable is a risk management platform that helps businesses manage exposure to volatile commodity prices.
company.description: Stable is a risk management platform that helps businesses around the world protect themselves from the untraded commodity price volatility derivatives market. It focuses on the 90% of commodities around the world that can’t be hedged currently on future market.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that uses AI to analyze and manage exposure to volatile commodity prices by matching commodities to third-party benchmarks and generating scenario analyses.
productsAndServices.name: Commodity Risk Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: Contracts that protect businesses from commodity price volatility by paying out if benchmark prices exceed predefined protection levels, with premiums as the only cost.
productsAndServices.name: Price Risk Protection Contracts

productsAndServices.description: Free AI-driven tools that provide weekly market insights and enable users to build and share risk management plans for tracked commodity markets.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Risk Analysis Tools

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $60,000,000, or 53.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $34,488,548 to $511,287,775, a 14.82x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 51 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
